links.outcome: Agreement between report-derived AI LVEF and standardized reassessment across centres
links.effect: ICC ≥ 0.86 overall and single-centre, but 95% limits of agreement all exceeded ±5%; 44.3% of cases differed >5% and 17.5% >10%.
links.quote: In 44.3% of cases > 5% differences between R-LVEF and M-LVEF were observed, and 17.5% showed > 10% differences.

links.outcome: Reproducibility and time of AI-assisted versus fully manual LVEF analysis by operators
links.effect: AI-assisted mode reduced assessment time; interobserver ICCs 0.968, 0.974, 0.984 vs 0.913, 0.924, 0.971 manual; CV 2.5%, 3.8%, 4.4% vs 5.6%, 8.8%, 9.3%.
links.quote: The AI-assisted method not only significantly reduced LVEF assessment time compared with manual analysis, but also showed superior reproducibility.

screen.reason: Empirical multicentre study evaluating the reproducibility and inter/intra-observer variability of AI-assisted workflow compared to fully manual cardiac MR quantification.
